posts.headline: Six straight editions of silence and Put it in Ra's league-best 20-8 pedigree is still stuck at 0-1 — One Nut Barner owes this league an explanation.
posts.detail: A 1.5 average finish and back-to-back titles-or-bust seasons don't excuse 123.66 points and a loss to open the year; the receipts are piling up and nobody's answering the door.

posts.headline: Sasinci's title banner keeps collecting dust — 0-1, 101.6 points, and a 13-15 career record that's now a full week worse than last time I checked in.
posts.detail: Big Head threatens to quit the league monthly, and at this rate the scoreboard might do it for him before October even starts.

posts.headline: talentedtenthh is somehow STILL unbeaten and I'm STILL not buying it — 120.4 points remains bottom-three in the entire league.
posts.detail: A 4-10, dead-last career résumé doesn't get to hide behind a lucky 1-0; the untalented tenth is winning on fumes and everybody in this league knows it.

posts.headline: Shake N Bakers snuck into the week with 201.76 points — the single highest score in the entire league — and nobody's talking about it.
posts.detail: A middling 6-7-1 career record and a 5th-place average finish didn't stop triciagloston from outscoring every contender and bottom-feeder alike; that's a statement stat line hiding in plain sight.

posts.headline: Thicks is 1-0 for a third straight week and I'm still not impressed — 138.94 points remains the softest winning score any title-pedigree team has managed all season.
posts.detail: One ring and a 5.5 average finish means Tyrique14 should be dominating, not squeaking by; a defending champ's crown shouldn't whisper this quietly for this long.
